    34	remain semantic constexpr handles in J.signature and never become C slots or
    35	values. Lift must classify their source use: any consequence that changes
    36	logical extent/value/predicate/result belongs only to J; representation-only
    37	layout/address realization may be referenced only by pi. A source constexpr
    38	not listed there is pure scheduling, remains a c* parameter, and must have a
    39	matching pure-C constexpr slot.

    42	binding, never permission to specialize J. If source uses that scalar in a
    43	logical extent, index, predicate, or result, create a symbolic x* dimension,
    44	use it in every affected J tensor shape, and set the scalar parameter's
    45	logical_ref to that x*. Symbolic dimensions are type/signature handles, not SSA
    46	values: never list x* in portable scope definitions/captures or storage.
    47	
    48	For every observable output, J.boundary.result_relations declares only the
    49	closed semantic comparison class; it never declares numeric thresholds. Use
    50	`exact` only when cross-backend equality is part of the logical contract (for
    51	example integer/boolean results or exactly specified copies). Floating
    52	transcendentals, floating reductions, and contracts that allow reassociation
    53	must use `tolerance`; the trusted external Gate2 policy Q supplies all atol,
    54	rtol, ULP, and NaN rules. Never place a Python comparator or a
    55	candidate-selected tolerance in J, C, or pi.

    58	`update_node_ref` that names an existing logical update.

    61	kind, target, node_ref (including null), and access_ref must agree exactly with

    70	not whole-tensor operators, but omitting them changes Gate1 realization
    71	closure; do not assume TypeCheck can infer an undeclared cast from source code.

    74	predicates, source topology, APIs, policy, or a strategy field.
